It contains the wlroots protocol files (wlr-protocols), from which it generates its Rust
bindings. Their copyright lines and licences, as the files state them:

MIT License (MIT):
- unstable/wlr-export-dmabuf-unstable-v1.xml: Copyright © 2018 Rostislav Pehlivanov

- unstable/wlr-virtual-pointer-unstable-v1.xml: Copyright © 2019 Josef Gajdusek
